en: The Chapter on Similes, Section on the Water-Jar.
6. The Question on the Factors of Food “Venerable Nāgasena, when you say that ‘three factors of food should be adopted,’ which are those three factors that should be adopted?
“Just as food, O King, is the support for all beings;”
In the same way, Great King, a practitioner of yoga must become a support for the path for all beings.
This, Great King, is the first quality of food that should be adopted.
Furthermore, Great King, food increases the strength of all beings.
In the same way, Great King, a practitioner of yoga should increase his merit.
This, Great King, is the second quality of food that should be adopted.
Furthermore, Great King, food is desired by all beings.
In the same way, Great King, a practitioner of yoga who is devoted to the practice must be one who aspires to all the world.
This, Great King, is the third quality of food that should be adopted.
And this, Great King, was said by the Elder Mahāmoggallāna:
one who has made the aspiration must become [perfected].
“...by the yogi for the sake of the entire world.
Thus ends the sixth inquiry, the Question on the Factor of Food.
